description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Career Change Mode II (Ice, Earth, Water) v2], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Laguna Freak Mode I (Ward)] and [Water/Ice/Earth Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Laguna Freak Mode I (Ward)
description.text: Water, Ice and Earth abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Water, Ice and Earth abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/2.50/3.00 for equipped Water, Ice and Earth abilities after using 1/2/3+ Water, Ice or Earth abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Laguna Freak Mode II (Ward)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Laguna Freak Mode II (Ward)
description.text: Water, Ice and Earth abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Water, Ice and Earth abilities, casts Dual Anchor Crash after using a Water, Ice or Earth ability

description.name: Dual Anchor Crash
description.text: One single ranged attack (2.57) capped at 99999, 100% hit rate, grants [Critical Damage +50% 2], [Deadly Strikes +20% 2] and [Quick Cast 2] to the user, Laguna and Kiros if Laguna and Kiros are alive, grants [Critical Damage +50% 2] to the user if 0-1 of Laguna and Kiros are alive

description.name: Critical Damage +50% 2
description.text: Critical hits deal 50% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient)

description.name: Deadly Strikes +20% 2
description.text: Critical hits deal 20% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient and other Critical Damage statuses)

description.name: Career Change Mode II (Ice, Earth, Water) v2

description.name: Water/Ice/Earth Resonance +5% Boost
